title: Table 1. U.S. Energy Markets Summary, September 2026

tables.label: Table 1. U.S. Energy Markets Summary

structure.description: One label column, twelve quarterly columns grouped by three years, and three annual columns. Numeric body has no per-row grid; some labels occupy two lines and macroeconomic series include growth-rate subrows. Five bold section labels and shaded forecast areas.

tables.notes: Header rules and a strong vertical divider before annual totals. Dot leaders connect unit labels to data. Long labels and some numbers appear crowded or clipped in the source render; no completion of those strings is attempted.
